name: keystone-vectorworks
description: Lets Claude draw exact, well-organised 2D plans in your open Vectorworks drawing: no gaps, no overlaps, true arcs, every object in the right class and layer.
long_description:
Keystone for Vectorworks by Seraphin Ernst – exact 2D drawing tools for architects – inside Claude. Claude draws polygons, polylines with true arcs, rectangles, circles, lines, text and dimensions in your open Vectorworks file, reads back what Vectorworks stored (deviation: 0), checks the drawing for overlaps, gaps, near misses, duplicates, double lines and open outlines with a numbered check image, and fixes them exactly. Layers and classes are used properly: new objects get their attributes by class.

Requires Vectorworks 2026 or 2027 on macOS. Nothing to set up in Vectorworks: the bridge is installed automatically and started directly. Also: a catalogue of exact symbols (sanitary, kitchen, furniture, trees, people, cars) and rule-based sorting onto classes and layers. Everything stays on this Mac (~/.vwmcp); nothing is sent anywhere else. Based on giorgiomoroder/vectorworks-mcp (MIT). New in 0.6: the planning knowledge of the four Raumpilot books (Wüstenrot Stiftung) - space needs and movement areas of every element, VDI 6000 distances, barrier-free values, room sizes and over 700 rules with their source pages; rooms are planned from the book's standard situations, checked and drawn in the Raumpilot look or in your office's own style and symbols.

vw_version.title: Vectorworks-Version
vw_version.description: Leer lassen: Keystone nimmt das laufende Vectorworks (2026 oder 2027). Nur wenn mehrere Versionen gleichzeitig laufen, hier die Jahreszahl eintragen, z. B. 2027.

trigger.title: Auslöser
trigger.description: Leer lassen (= direct): Keystone startet die Brücke direkt, kein Menübefehl nötig. "menu": über den Menübefehl „MCP Run Job“ (wie bis Version 0.4).

tools.name: vw2d_structure
tools.description: Layers, classes and scales of the open drawing, with organisation problems.

tools.name: vw2d_read
tools.description: 2D objects with exact geometry and attributes.

tools.name: vw2d_draw
tools.description: Draws exact 2D objects (true arcs, mm/cm/m, chains) in a layer and class.

tools.name: vw2d_check
tools.description: Finds overlaps, gaps, near misses, duplicates, double lines and open outlines, with a check image.

tools.name: vw2d_fix
tools.description: Fixes check issues exactly: snap, close, clean, duplicates, overlaps, merge, by class.

tools.name: vw2d_edit
tools.description: Replaces outlines or moves single points exactly.

tools.name: vw2d_transform
tools.description: Moves, rotates, mirrors or scales objects, also point onto point.

tools.name: vw2d_boolean
tools.description: Union, subtract, intersect and split with arcs kept as arcs.

tools.name: vw2d_offset
tools.description: Exact offset of outlines.

tools.name: vw2d_setup
tools.description: Creates classes with attributes and design layers with scale.

tools.name: vw2d_set_attributes
tools.description: Sets class, layer, name and attributes (default: by class).

tools.name: vw2d_delete
tools.description: Deletes objects (restorable).

tools.name: vw2d_preview
tools.description: Check image of an area or one issue.

tools.name: vw2d_resources
tools.description: Hatches and line types of the drawing and the Vectorworks library.

tools.name: vw2d_select
tools.description: Selects and zooms to objects in Vectorworks.

tools.name: vw2d_organize
tools.description: Sorts objects onto classes and layers by rules (dry run first, one revertable step).

tools.name: vw2d_knowledge
tools.description: Planning knowledge of the Raumpilot books: space needs, movement areas, distances, room sizes, standard layouts and rules with sources.

tools.name: vw2d_plan_room
tools.description: Plans a room (bath, WC, kitchen, dining ...) from the book's standard situations and the rules, checks the variants, draws the chosen one.

tools.name: vw2d_place_element
tools.description: Places planning elements with their movement areas in the active drawing style.

tools.name: vw2d_check_room
tools.description: Checks a drawn room against the planning rules (movement areas, distances, door).

tools.name: vw2d_style
tools.description: The drawing style: Raumpilot look as first layer, your office's classes, colours and own symbols on top.

tools.name: vw2d_assets
tools.description: Detailed symbols for elevations and sections (sanitary, furniture, trees, people, cars).

tools.name: vw2d_place_asset
tools.description: Places those symbols exactly, oriented to the wall.

tools.name: vw_revert_last
tools.description: Undoes exactly Claude's last step.

tools.name: vw_ping
tools.description: Checks the connection to Vectorworks.
